product.name: Monoprice Outdoor Extension Cord - NEMA 5-15P to NEMA 5-15R 16AWG 13A/1625W SJTW White 12ft
product.description: This white 12‑foot outdoor extension cord is ideal for lawn, garden, and landscaping uses, as well as holiday lighting and other electrical yard decorations. It features a grounded NEMA® 5‑15 plug on one end and a grounded NEMA 5‑15 outlet on the other end.This outdoor extension cord is water and abrasion resistant and features a flame retardant SJTW jacket. It has nickel‑coated brass blades, which resist corrosion, and it remains flexible in temperatures from ‑40 ~ +140°F. This ETL certified extension cord features 16 AWG stranded copper conductors and is rated for 13 amps/1625 watts at 125 VAC.Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc. NEMA® is a registered trademark of National Electrical Manufacturers Association. PRIME® and the PRIME logo are registered trademarks of Prime Wire & Cable, Inc. Updated Jul 27, 2021
